reason: A command-line integration that lets local AI coding agents provision Meoo cloud services, manage project data and environment variables, synchronize code, and deploy applications.

summaries.zh: 面向本地 AI 编程助手的命令行工具，用于管理 Meoo 云端数据库、登录、文件存储、代码同步和应用部署。
summaries.en: A command-line integration for local AI coding assistants to manage Meoo cloud databases, authentication, storage, code synchronization, and application deployment.

capabilities: Authenticates with a remote Meoo account and stores credentials
Provisions PostgreSQL, authentication, and file storage services
Reads and writes cloud project environment variables
Executes SQL queries against a remote database
Synchronizes code with a cloud sandbox
Builds and deploys projects and edge functions to a CDN
